allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Rookie cop Alicia West, an Army veteran, inadvertently captures the murder of a young drug dealer on her body cam. After realizing that the murder was committed by corrupt cops, she teams up with the one person from her community who is willing to help her as she tries to escape both the criminals out for revenge and the police who are desperate to destroy the incriminating footage.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Trapped between corrupt officers hunting the camera and vengeful locals closing in, who can she rely on to help get the truth out alive?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After rookie cop and Army veteran Alicia West inadvertently records corrupt fellow officers committing murder on her body camera, she becomes the target of both dirty police and vengeful criminals on the streets.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and suspenseful action thriller with sharp institutional danger and relentless street-level pursuit.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Deon Taylor delivers a fast, hard-hitting crime thriller that turns a high-stakes evidence race into a relentless, tension-fueled fight for survival.
